expansions.body:
set -eu
sha='3f1c00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000a1e9'
name='diskwatch-0.8.0'
dest='/usr/local/bin/diskwatch'
mode='0755'
owner='root'
src="/var/tmp/vpscfg-push/$sha/$name"
if [ -L "$dest" ] || [ -d "$dest" ]; then
  echo "install_pushed: $dest is a symlink or a directory; not installed" >&2
  exit 3
fi
if ! echo "$sha  $src" | sha256sum --check --status; then
  echo "install_pushed: $src is missing or does not have the approved hash; not installed" >&2
  exit 3
fi
d=${dest%/*}; [ -n "$d" ] || d=/
t=$(mktemp "$d/.vpscfg-install.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$t"' EXIT
install -m "$mode" -o "$owner" -g "$owner" "$src" "$t"
if ! echo "$sha  $t" | sha256sum --check --status; then
  echo "install_pushed: the installed copy does not have the approved hash; not moved into place" >&2
  exit 3
fi
mv -fT "$t" "$dest"
echo "installed $dest ($mode $owner)"
expansions.check: echo '3f1c00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000a1e9' '' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | sha256sum --check --status && stat -c '%a' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | grep -qx '755' && stat -c '%U' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | grep -qx 'root' && echo VPSCFG-DONE || echo VPSCFG-NEEDED
expansions.verify: echo '3f1c00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000a1e9' '' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | sha256sum --check --status && stat -c '%a' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | grep -qx '755' && stat -c '%U' '/usr/local/bin/diskwatch' | grep -qx 'root'
